$description: Playback scope tokens (added by ds.py init when playback is enabled, directly or via video/live/music/podcast/reading/messaging). The media surface is always dark in every theme.

surface.$description: Player surface: always dark in every theme (video letterbox, control bar).

scrim.$description: Caption/control scrim behind text. Opaque here; apply alpha in CSS only when the measured result still meets 4.5:1.

fg.$description: Icons and text on the player. 19.65:1 on surface, 21.0:1 on scrim.

rail.$description: Seek/volume track rail; darkened so the played range keeps >=3:1 against it.

buffered.$description: Buffered range, kept between rail and played; 3.26:1 against played and 6.8:1 against the white thumb (3:1 UI minimum each).

played.$description: Played range; 5.88:1 against rail, 3.26:1 against buffered (3:1 UI minimum).

live.$description: LIVE badge/edge marker fill; 3.49:1 on surface (3:1 UI), white live-fg text on it 5.62:1. Always with the text LIVE.

focus.$description: Focus ring on media controls; 13.92:1 on surface.
